description: Source-local ignored-setting probes for the validated classic external ripple Print pipeline.

mutants.description: Ignore fuzzy_skin_ripples_per_layer in the classic ripple consumer. The cycle-count testcase must fail at the registered minimum and representative count while phase and group cases pass.
Ignore fuzzy_skin_ripple_offset when computing layer phase. The offset and group tests must lose their expected half-cycle inversion while the cycle-count case passes.
Ignore fuzzy_skin_layers_between_ripple_offset by applying the phase on every layer. The three-layer group case must fail its same-phase group assertions while the one-layer phase case passes.
